decision: PROVISIONAL pending roster eligibility and explicit public measurement-row linkage; no numerical stage
source_level_conditions: 31 consecutive patients Dalian2013–14;8 excluded,23 analyzed, mixed soft-tissue tumors. Explicit EMC enrollment not yet inspected. No molecular authentication or diagnosis-to-data-row inference.
source_acquisition: 3T GE SignaHDxt SE-EPI,10 b-values0,10,20,30,50,100,200,300,500,800 s/mm2; conventional MRI plus gadolinium dynamic sequence. Parenchymal ROIs excluding necrosis/cysts/large vessels. Nine technical ROIs over three consecutive images per patient.
assay_interpretation: ADCstandard, ADCslow, ADCfast and IVIMf are different fitted diffusion/signal parameters. Coefficient units ordinarily area/time but exact source column scaling must be authenticated without values. f is model signal fraction, not measured flow, vessel density or oxygen tension. No actual histologic vessel or oxygen pairing established.
prior_art_reused: Existing MRI review already establishes known high-ADC myxoid benign/malignant ambiguity and lack of explicit crosswalk in other cohorts. A newly found source or one labeled EMC fitting example is not a finding. No threshold or medical-image inspection undertaken.
strongest_alternative: Matrix free water, cellularity, b-value/model noise and ROI selection can affect fitted diffusion/fast-component signal; cannot infer a microvascular or oxygen phenotype uniquely.
coverage: All23 final roster labels and8 excluded conditions must be dispositioned if readable. Unspecified generic histology, therapy and overlap remain pending. Old OA API404 was only failure of that route, not proof PDF absent.
